notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed passive Wheeljack VO playing over some loading screens.
- Fixed some issues with Korean Language Setting.
- Fixed a bug which displayed unpurchaseable owned Abilities in Wheeljack's Lab.

notes.title: Hotfix for DLC owners (Including Deluxe Edition)
notes.notes:
An update (r15767) for TRANSFORMERS: BATTLEGROUNDS has been released. The fixes affect access to purchasable DLC including:

[list]
[*] Purchased Skins are now selectable in the SELECT YOUR SQUAD screen for [i]all[/i] players who have either purchased Skin packs separately or own the Deluxe Edition.
[*] CUBE game is now selectable in Arcade Mode for [i]all[/i] players who have purchased the Deluxe Edition.
[/list]

We are sorry to all players who have been inconvenienced, thank you for your patience!
